title: External substrate identity manifest
description: A small, repository-governed cryptographic description of the external COMMERCIAL_BUYER_READINESS_V1 substrate. It is Layer B in the A/B/C separation: it is NOT the substrate bytes (Layer A, 232 GB, never copied here) and NOT legal authority (Layer C). Identity is bound to the bytes of a fixed critical-object set and the counts re-derived from the live registries; it is deliberately independent of the absolute pathname so the substrate can be relocated.

canonical_observed_path.description: Where the substrate was observed. NOT load-bearing — verification matches by bytes, not path.

path_binding.description: Corroborating evidence: verify_readiness.py hardcodes its ROOT under this tree.

critical_objects.description: {relpath: {sha256, bytes}} over the fixed critical set.

critical_set_digest.description: sha256 over the sorted {relpath: sha256} map. Path-independent.

expected_counts.description: Structural counts re-derived from the live registries at build time. Verification re-derives them and fails closed on drift.

generation_basis.description: Deterministic; no wall-clock embedded so a rebuild reproduces the manifest.

identity_class.description: EXACT_PRIOR_SUBSTRATE requires authorship/path binding + exact critical-object hashes + exact count fingerprint. It never claims commit lineage (vcs_lineage is unavailable).
